description: Convert any photo to pure black and white using an adjustable threshold slider.

faqs.a: Every pixel's brightness is compared to your threshold: brighter becomes white, darker becomes black.
Yes — the preview updates live as you drag the threshold from 0 to 255.
Great for line art, stamps, silhouettes and high-contrast graphics.
A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Drag the threshold slider until the black-and-white balance looks right.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Threshold
